title: Close-area search for B: frontier, nominal-first, lawnmower and random-walk arms when B is a region or unknown, then A* to the detected B
summary: Search arms for the case where B is a marker, a nominal position or an area, not a coordinate. B is given as a nominal point with radius 0, 2 or 5 m (true B uniform in the disk) or not at all; it is detected when the vehicle is within 2 m with a clear line of sight (range from the fiducial-goal-apriltag harsh-image sweep, rate 1.00 at 2 m for 0-50 deg). Arms, all driving with the close-area-arena unknown-map A* + ESDF follower on its log-odds map: nearest frontier (Yamauchi 1997 frontiers, nearest by scipy csgraph Dijkstra path length), nominal-first then frontier inside the region, boustrophedon lawnmower over the region (3 m lanes), random waypoints, and an oracle reference with B given. Then A* to the detected B. bench.py runs random, office and warehouse layouts, 20 per family, ideal and crazyflie range presets, 180 s budget, and reports found %, reached %, collision % with Wilson intervals, time to find and time to B. analyze.py relates frontier failures to map coverage. export_replay.py writes one close-area-replay/2 file with the world in close-area-world/1. numpy + scipy only, no threads in the core module.
verified: ran 2026-11-10 with CPython 3.12.10 + numpy 2.5.4 / scipy 1.18.1 on an Apple M3 Max (macOS 26.6.2 arm64), in a sample venv built from requirements.txt (numpy + scipy only, matplotlib absent): bench.py --layouts 20 --seed 0 --jobs 14 ran 1560 runs in 460.5 s and wrote results/bench_0.*; re-run 2026-11-12 with the arena's dropped-beam fix on (--jobs 10, 556.2 s, same interpreter), after a 104-row rerun with the fix off reproduced the 2026-11-10 rows exactly; analyze.py wrote results/analysis_0.md (map coverage per outcome, and a rerun of the 11 ideal frontier runs that ended hovering: 11 of 11 had no frontier left); export_replay.py wrote one replay whose outcome and min clearance match its bench row and whose world round-trips through world_json.from_json. test_smoke.py: 3 passed in the venv (one reruns a bench row and matches outcome, time to find, path length and clearance), 3 skipped under plain python3 without numpy. No arena file was edited. Not run under Pyodide. Layouts, vehicle, range sensor and detection are simulated; true pose; no camera, no SITL, no flight.
shows: Finding B when it is a region or unknown: frontier, nominal-first, lawnmower and random-walk search on the unknown-map A*, 2 m line-of-sight detection, random / office / warehouse, ideal and crazyflie sensors, found % with Wilson intervals
runtime: ~9 min on 10 processes for 1560 runs; one run 0.3-15 s
key_result: [60 layouts per cell, ideal sensor](README.md#results-ran-2026-11-10-apple-m3-max-macos-2662-cpython-31210-numpy-254-scipy-1181): with a nominal within 2 m every arm found B in 86.7-95.0 % of runs (oracle reached 93.3 %); with R = 5 m random_walk 85.0 %, lawnmower 83.3 %, nominal_frontier 81.7 % (fastest, median 26.3 s to find); with B unknown nearest-frontier found only 41.7 % [30.1, 54.3] in 180 s because the 6 m range map completes before the 2 m detector has swept the room; crazyflie preset: oracle itself collides in 38.3 %

readiness.limitation: Synthetic 2.5D point-mass arena, geometric 2 m omnidirectional detection without false positives, true pose, seed 0 only (partly a tuning seed); offline run not checked; Pyodide not tried; Linux not tested.
